item.title: github: GitHub Copilot Fusion updates: more availability, benchmarks, and models
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Fusion is being expanded with additional models, broader availability across Copilot surfaces, and benchmark results published on two public Terminal-Bench leaderboards. The update also gives users more options for comparing Fusion performance.

  • Source: GitHub
